shared_elements: writing/script signs arranged in ordered blocks or rows
script signs including human and animal head forms
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by dense, ordered script signs set in rows/columns within a bounded field, and both sign systems include small human and animal figures as glyph elements. But the specific content differs entirely: B shows a large figural scene of standing human figures with raised arms flanking a rayed disc above horizontal text registers, while A shows only stacked square glyph blocks in double columns with no figural tableau, and the sign forms and proportions follow unrelated conventions.
